title: Auth Sequence (Login + Authenticated Request)
purpose: Login flow (email/password → Supabase Auth → JWT → frontend storage) + authenticated request flow (Bearer token → protect middleware → Supabase getUser → profile fetch → reshape → controller) + unauthenticated request rejection.
audience: Engineers debugging auth flows, security reviewers
description: Complete authentication sequence covering three paths: (1) Login flow where frontend submits credentials, auth middleware calls supabase.auth.signInWithPassword, receives user+session, fetches profile from DB, reshapes for frontend, returns { user, token }. (2) Authenticated request flow where protect middleware extracts Bearer token, calls supabase.auth.getUser for remote JWT verification, fetches full profile, applies impersonation check, attaches req.user, and passes to controller. (3) Unauthenticated request rejection returning 401 'Not authorized, no token provided'. Two Supabase API calls per authenticated request (JWT verify + user lookup) with no caching.

actors.label: Frontend (React SPA)
actors.description: React application making auth requests. Stores JWT in localStorage/sessionStorage. Uses apiClient.ts interceptor to attach Bearer token to all requests.

modules.label: Auth Middleware (auth.middleware.ts)
modules.description: Express middleware that validates JWT via Supabase Auth API, fetches user profile, applies role guards, and checks impersonation header.

modules.label: Controller (auth.controller.ts / other)
modules.description: Request handler that receives req.user from middleware and delegates to service layer.

modules.label: Supabase Auth API
modules.description: External JWT authentication service. Provides signInWithPassword, getUser, and user management via admin API.

modules.label: Supabase DB (profiles table)
modules.description: PostgreSQL profiles table storing user data. Queried via findUserById/get_user_details RPC after JWT validation.

dataStores.label: Profiles Table (Supabase DB)
dataStores.description: PostgreSQL table with columns: id, username, email, role, status, profile (JSONB), creator_data (JSONB), preferences (JSONB), etc. Queried via findUserById after JWT validation.

entryPoints.label: POST /api/v1/auth/login
entryPoints.description: Login request from frontend with { email, password } in request body.

entryPoints.label: GET /api/v1/users/me (authenticated)
entryPoints.description: Authenticated request with Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

entryPoints.label: GET /api/v1/users/me (no token)
entryPoints.description: Request without Authorization header—tests middleware rejection.

exitPoints.label: { success, data: { user, token } }
exitPoints.description: Successful login response with reshaped user profile and JWT access token.

exitPoints.label: Controller processes request with req.user
exitPoints.description: Authenticated request proceeds to controller with user object attached.

preconditions: User has valid credentials (email + password) in Supabase Auth
User profile exists in profiles table linked by auth user ID
Frontend has Supabase client configured with anon key
postconditions: Login: JWT token returned and stored in localStorage/sessionStorage via useAuth.tsx
Authenticated request: req.user attached with full reshaped profile for downstream use
Unauthenticated request: 401 returned, no side effects

decisions.truePath: Fetch profile → reshape → check impersonation → attach req.user → proceed

decisions.condition: X-Impersonating-User-Id header present AND user is admin?
decisions.truePath: Fetch target user profile, set req.originalUser=admin, req.user=targetUser

errorPaths.destination: 401 'Not authorized' returned, frontend apiClient interceptor clears token from storage
errorPaths.recovery: User must re-authenticate via login page

errorPaths.destination: 404 'User profile not found' or 401 depending on route
errorPaths.recovery: User cannot access the platform—no recovery path exists
Retry on next request once Supabase is reachable

validationRules: Email and password required for login—controller validates presence
Token must be present and non-empty in Authorization header
JWT must be valid (not expired, correct signature) per Supabase Auth API
businessRules: Every authenticated request makes 2 Supabase API calls: getUser + findUserById
No caching of auth state—each request re-validates token remotely
autoRefreshToken: false on server-side Supabase client—no automatic token refresh
securityConsiderations: JWT stored in localStorage—vulnerable to XSS
Two unprotected referral routes bypass this entire auth flow
No rate limiting on login endpoint—brute force possible
No token blacklist/revocation—logout is client-side only
Auth debug log (auth.middleware.ts:20-23) writes PII to debug.log
performanceConsiderations: 2 Supabase API calls per authenticated request (~100-300ms each)
Remote JWT verification via Supabase Auth—no local JWT decode caching

annotations.text: No local JWT decode—every request makes remote API call to validate token
reshapeUserForApp called at 23 sites—most-called internal function
Also checks impersonation header—see B-02 Impersonation Flow for details
